notes.title: Play The Jackbox Survey Scramble Today!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948640/The_Jackbox_Survey_Scramble/

Jackbox has made an all-new party experience! Taking real surveys from real people around the globe, The Jackbox Survey Scramble is constantly changing based on answers submitted from players, including you! Invite your friends, family, coworkers, and enemies to see how they think when it comes to questions like, “In one word, what’s the cutest nickname for butts?” or “In one word, what’s the best sandwich topping?”

[h3][b]Multiple New Game Modes[/b][/h3]
[list][*] [b]Hilo:[/b] Can you guess the most popular one-word cat names? How about the least? In Hilo, compete to find the most and least popular answers to a wide variety of questions. The rankings may surprise you! It turns out a lot of people named their cat Frank. That's a freebie.
[*] [b]Speed:[/b] In the fast-paced Speed, think on your toes to uncover as many answers on the list as possible, as quickly as possible. It’s everyone for themselves in a race against the clock! Each round the points increase, and the stakes get a little higher! Can you handle it?
[*] [b]Squares:[/b] Two teams compete to claim three squares in a row on the grid. Guess popular choices for the first squares, semi-popular choices for the middle squares, and least popular choices for the final squares. We guarantee, you've never had a more heated argument over attractive fictional characters than you will playing Squares.
[*] [b]Bounce:[/b] In Bounce, two teams control a paddle that sits on a scale between most popular-to-least popular answers. Work with your team to guess an answer that puts your paddle in the right place to intercept a bouncing ball and stop your opponents from scoring a goal! But be careful! The ball gets faster with each answer![/list]
[b]But wait… there’s more! We’ll be releasing a free game update featuring two new game modes in a couple months 👀 So what are you waiting for? Get The Jackbox Survey Scramble now for just $9.99 USD.[/b]



[i]Play with your phone or tablet - no special controller required. All games support 2 to 8 players and 10,000 audience members. All Jackbox Survey Scramble games can be played in English, French, Italian, German, Castilian or Latin American Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese. And we'll be making sure we have localized answers for the UK and Australia, as well.[/i]

notes.title: Add The Jackbox Naughty Pack to your Wishlist on Steam Today!
notes.content:
What’s The Jackbox Naughty Pack? I’m so pleased you asked. Take a seat on my perfectly maintained 70s chic conversation pit couch, grab at least two friends, and get ready for an absolutely raucous game night. 

The Jackbox Naughty Pack is rated M for Mature. Watch the trailer to learn more here:

 [previewyoutube=FTAYOPKYDuU;full][/previewyoutube]

Get ready to play three tantalizingly silly party games, each supporting 3-8 players:
[list]
[*] [h3][b]Fakin’ It All Night Long[/b][/h3] (Social Deduction): Fakin’ It returns and this time we’re putting it all out there. Everyone gets a secret task except the Faker, who tries to blend in. Find out which of your friends is the best liar… and SO much more! Featuring new categories and a brand new “remote play” mode. 
[*] [h3][b]Dirty Drawful[/b][/h3] (Drawing, Guessing): It’s Drawful, but  dirty… It’s Dirty Drawful. We’ve taken the Drawful that you love and added spicy prompts to ensure your drawings are both terrible and titillating. We also may have added an “undo” button for this one, but don’t tell anyone. 
[*] [h3][b]Let Me Finish[/b][/h3] (Debate): Let Me Finish is Jackbox’s new presentation game that examines life’s serious questions like, “Where is the mailbox’s butt?” or “How does this avocado get aroused?” Everyone gets a chance to speak their mind but will others pick up what you’re putting down?
[/list]
The Jackbox Naughty Pack will launch this Thursday, [b]September 12, 2024[/b] and retail for [b]$21.69[/b] ([i]nice[/i]). This product will be available on all major platforms upon release.

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2652000/The_Jackbox_Naughty_Pack/][i][b]Add it to your wishlist on Steam now! [/b][/i][/url][/h2]

notes.title: This update is dynamite
notes.content:
A free update to The Jackbox Party Pack 2 is now available! For the second month of 2023, we’re celebrating the second Party Pack! This update includes improvements to Bomb Corp, a game where you take the role of an office intern who is tasked with normal intern responsibilities such as diffusing bombs. 

Our team has long been looking forward to patching in improvements for Bomb Corp based on fan-requested features. Today you can enjoy the following updates:

Death is not the end. If you die in the game, you can now select “Retry” to retry the exact puzzle sequence you died on and continue from there if you succeed.

Take it easy. We adjusted the difficulty for filing puzzles. The number of names to file for each difficulty level has been reduced.

Adjective puzzle (Written By Kids) moved. Day 3 had a filing puzzle and the super tough Adjective Puzzle, making it way too difficult early in the game. We moved this around to give players an easier time early on.

First 5 days now have slightly increased timers and decreased puzzle difficulties. The middle 5 days have a very slight decrease in difficulty. 

Decreased thresholds for star levels across all days. 

With these changes, do you think you can now beat Bomb Corp? Tune in to our live stream at 5 PM CT on Friday, February 24th to try it live over at twitch.tv/jackboxgames and youtube.com/jackboxgames. 

Check your consoles today to update your copy of The Jackbox Party Pack 2.

notes.title: The Jackbox Party Pack 2 version 1.02 is now live... with Trading Cards!
notes.content:
Just in time to save your Thanksgiving family gatherings from a case of the holiday awkwards, we’ve got a brand-spanking new version of The Jackbox Party Pack 2 fresh out of the oven and stuffed up to the gizzard with delicious fixin's!

And this year, we’re MOST thankful for The Jackbox Party Pack 2 Steam trading cards!!! That’s right, collect all TJPP2 game box cards and backgrounds, and show you know what’s what in the world of party games. Get ‘em while they’re hot and steamy!

Patch Notes:
[list]
[*]Steam Trading Cards have been added!
[*]Major update to Pause functionality - it actually pauses the game now!
[*]Bomb Corp: Filing bomb failure messaging now more accurate.
[*]Bomb Corp: Fixed copier bomb overheating warning indicator.
[*]Bomb Corp: Fixed not being able to complete Day 15 with 3 or 4 players.
[*]Quiplash: Fixed some host audio glitches.
[*]Fixed some possible freezes and soft-locks throughout each game.
[*]Fixed a few typos.
[/list]

We at Jackbox wish you and your family a fun, festive holiday with all the fresh fixes in this release. And again, we must remind you: We are not responsible for injuries sustained while uproariously laughing and a) cracking a rib, b) slapping your knee too hard and dislocating it, or c) snorting eggnog out your nose and burning off your sinus cavity lining. Or any combination thereof. Enjoy!
